eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Lincoln, MT; at 2:43 PM on JUL 31, 2026 Effective until 4:43 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Red flag warning for this weekend. West winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts of 40 mph. Any fires that develop will spread rapidly, outdoor burning is not recommended.
